name: What questions should I ask before hiring a luxury home builder?

mainEntity.name: What are the most important questions to ask a custom home builder before signing a contract?
mainEntity.text: What are the most important questions to ask a custom home builder before signing a contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: The strongest builder interview questions focus on process, not just promises. Ask how many similar ground-up luxury homes the team has completed recently, what types of lots and architecture they know best, who manages design coordination, how allowances are set, how often the budget is updated, and how change orders are approved. Also ask how they handle permitting, long-lead items, and schedule delays. For luxury homes, a builder’s ability to communicate clearly is as important as their craftsmanship. The right team should be able to explain their preconstruction process, show examples of complex projects, and describe exactly how they protect the budget and timeline. Vague answers are a warning sign.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about similar projects, recent ground-up builds, preconstruction deliverables, allowance strategy, change-order handling, long-lead procurement, and how budget and schedule updates are reported. The best answers should be specific, not generic.
